answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 6 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in voyage, checked in willow, and relic makes public each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. The per-identity price is 117 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
